approaches.title: Enumerate all three-digit even numbers
approaches.summary: Build a digit-frequency bucket, then test every three-digit even number against the available digit counts. This directly counts valid numbers without constructing permutations of the input positions.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Uses digit frequencies to validate each even number from 100 through 998. The bounded digit range makes the work effectively constant with respect to the input size.

approaches.title: Enumerate digit-index permutations
approaches.summary: Iterate over distinct input indices for the hundreds, tens, and units positions, requiring a nonzero hundreds digit and an even units digit. A boolean array removes duplicate numeric values caused by repeated digits.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces candidate-number checking with triple nested iteration over available digit positions. It records generated values in a seen array so duplicate numbers are counted once.
